subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md/bootstrap budget enforcement and an archive workflow, or keep this issue limited to diagnostics plus broader bounded-memory design work?
rationale: Current main already warns at runtime, doctor, and `/context`, but refusing saves and moving old memory content changes the workspace-file editing UX and persistent memory lifecycle.

options.title: Narrow Core UI Guard
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold Into Bounded Memory
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under the broader bounded-memory issue and treat this issue as overlapping diagnostics/UI evidence.

options.title: Diagnostics Only
options.body: Use the linked diagnostics PR path for more visibility but decline save-time enforcement and auto-archive in core for now.

recommendation.title: Narrow Core UI Guard
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blamed code and recent merged PR history make kasangyong the clearest available routing owner for the bootstrap budget diagnostics that a UI guard would reuse.
